products.title: Gigabyte GeForce RTX 5050 Gaming OC 8GB GDDR6
products.body_html:
Gigabyte GeForce RTX 5050 Gaming OC 8GB GDDR6

 

Performance and Features

  • Target resolution: The card is best suited for 1080p gaming, especially for esports titles and less demanding games. For graphically intense AAA games, reviewers recommend using upscaling and adjusting settings.
  • DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation (MFG): As part of the RTX 50 series, the card supports DLSS 4. This technology is essential for boosting frame rates in modern games, though it can introduce noticeable input latency, particularly with higher-end settings.
  • Ray tracing: While the card supports ray tracing, its limited processing power and 8GB of VRAM mean that enabling it can result in significant performance drops and is not recommended for most modern games.
  • Architectural limitations: The desktop version of the RTX 5050 uses older GDDR6 memory instead of the faster GDDR7 found on higher-end RTX 50-series cards and the RTX 5050 laptop GPU. It also uses a PCIe 5.0 x8 interface, which can limit performance on older PCIe 3.0 motherboards.

products.title: ASUS Dual GeForce RTX™ 5060 Ti 16GB GDDR7 OC Edition DDR7 Gaming Graphics Card
products.body_html:
DUAL GEFORCE RTX™ 5060 Ti
Dual Fans, Perfect Fit

ASUS Dual GeForce RTX™ 5060 Ti combines powerful thermal performance with broad compatibility. Advanced cooling solutions from flagship graphics cards — including two Axial-tech fans for optimizing airflow to the heatsink. Designed in a compact 2.5-slot form factor, delivering more power in less space. These enhancements make ASUS Dual the perfect choice for gamers who want heavyweight graphics performance in a compact build.

Key Features:

  • 2.5 Slot Design - Compatible with small-form-factor builds
  • Axial-Tech Fans - Longer blades improve airflow and dispersion
  • Vented Backplate - Enhanced cooling for optimal performance
  • Dual-Ball Fan Bearings - Up to twice the lifespan of sleeve bearings
  • Dual BIOS - Toggle between Performance or Quiet modes
  • GPUTweak III - Ultimate GPU tuning utility
  • MuseTree - Grow your dreams with AI magic

Cooling

2.5-slot Design
A carefully designed shroud, heatsink, and heatpipe layout enables the two Axial-tech fans to leverage chassis side-panel ventilation, delivering thermal performance that beyond thecompact size.

Axial-tech Upgrades
Two tried-and-true Axial-tech fans feature a smaller hub facilitates longer blades and a barrier ring to increase downward air pressure.

0dB Technology
To eliminate unnecessary noise, the stop mode automatically halts all fans when the GPU temperature drops below 50 degrees and power consumption is low.

Dual Ball Fan Bearings
Fan bearings come in different types, each with its own advantages. Dual ball bearings provide superior durability and can last up to twice as long as sleeve-bearing designs.

Vented Backplate
A vented backplate significantly enhance heat dissipation, helping to keep the GPU cooler during intense tasks. This additional airflow helps ensure optimal temperatures, boosting performance, longevity and stability by defending against overheating and thermal throttling.

Unmatched Reliability

ASUS GPU Guard
ASUS GPU Guard applies adhesive to secure all four corners to reduce the risk of cracks.

Protective Backplate
The PCB is reinforced by a backplate that adds structural rigidity, helping to prevent flex and to protect components and trace pathways from damage.

Stainless Steel Bracket
The mounting bracket of the Dual has been beefed up with 304 Stainless Steel that’s harder and more resistant to corrosion.

Engineering

Dual BIOS
Do you prioritize lower core temperatures or quieter operation? Performance mode increases fan speed to keep the card running cool all the time. Quiet mode maintains the same power target and performance settings, but applies a less aggressive fan curve for quieter operation at medium temperatures. Want more control? Customize your experience with GPU Tweak III software for fine-tuned fan profiles and performance adjustments.

Auto−Extreme Technology
Auto-Extreme Technology is an automated manufacturing process that sets new standards in the industry by allowing completing all soldering to be completed in a single pass. This reduces thermal strain on components and avoids the use of harsh cleaning chemicals, resulting and minimizes in less environmental impact. The result is lower power consumption during manufacturing and a more reliable, high-quality product. Lower manufacturing power consumption, and a more reliable product overall.

  • Model: DUAL-RTX5060TI-O16G
  • Graphic Engine: NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5060 Ti
  • AI Performance: 759 TOPs
  • Bus Standard: PCI Express 5.0
  • OpenGL: OpenGL®4.6
  • Video Memory: 16GB GDDR7
  • Engine Clock: OC mode: 2632MHz / Default mode: 2602MHz (Boost Clock)
  • CUDA Core: 4608
  • Memory Speed: 28 Gbps
  • Memory Interface: 128-bit

  • Maximum Display Support:4

  • Software: ASUS GPU Tweak III & MuseTree & GeForce Game Ready Driver & Studio Driver: please download all software from the support site.
